sections.headline: S&P 500 Falls on Yield Concerns
sections.body: The S&P 500 fell 0.06% to 7647.15 as investors watched Treasury yields surge, sparking concerns about inflation. The rise in yields is a sign that investors are pricing in higher interest rates, which can make borrowing more expensive. This is a key concern for the stock market, as higher interest rates can lead to lower stock prices. [4]

sections.headline: Nasdaq Falls
sections.body: The Nasdaq fell 0.12% to 26827.77, as traders watched for signs of inflationary pressures and rising interest rates. The Dow and S&P 500 also fell, with the Dow dropping 0.13% and the S&P 500 remaining flat. The 10-year Treasury yield rose to a new 24-year high, sparking concerns about cost pressures and the impact on tech stocks.
